intent.problem: Security events are hard to interpret as they happen.
intent.target_users: Mac owners and local security reviewers.

safety.reason: Read existing evidence, preserve uncertainty, and never remediate the machine.

product.benefit: See which observed security events need review and what supports each assessment.
product.problem: Live system logs are noisy and individual events need context.
product.how_it_works: Observes two minutes of new macOS unified log events and checks them for specific security signals.
product.input: Output folder. Live log collection starts automatically with each run.
product.output: Web report with assessment, timestamped evidence and coverage. JSON and Markdown copies are also saved.
product.target_users: Mac owners and local security reviewers.
product.simulation_type: Each run watches the submitting Mac.
